newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GE Capital says has 86 pct of Loscam.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital says has 86 pct of Loscam.

text.p: GE Capital Services said on Friday it had 86 percent of pallet group Loscam Ltd under its 43 cent per share takeover bid.

"GE Capital Services has received a significant number of acceptances this week, including acceptances from GIO Australia and the Argo Group. GE Capital Services is now entitled to approximately 86 percent of Loscam's issued capital," it said in a statement.
There was market speculation last month that GE would not reach its target after NRMA Ltd and Perpetual Funds Management increased their stakes in Loscam to 7.8 percent and 5.2 percent respectively.
GE Capital, a unit of U.S.-based General Electric Co, said it had extended its unconditional bid to April 16 and would not raise its offer price, which values Loscam at A$54 million.
Loscam shares last traded at 43.5 cents on April 9.
